title: Christ Church Cathedral, Grafton

buildingCutout.basis: The outer walls and attached vestries use the native footprint on the cathedral grounds.

terrainReference.basis: Original Copernicus datum on the lawn of the main west approach.

identities.name: Christ Church Cathedral, Grafton
identities.address: Duke Street at Fitzroy Street, Grafton, New South Wales

mapIdentity.scope: The photographed historic complex and the named extant cathedral are tied by the standing wall outline, east and west faces, and the matching Wikidata identity.

note: The published 1888 bird’s-eye view shows the first phase, main roof and lower aisle. Heritage NSW and the cathedral conservators record the 1937 continuation with eight nave bays, west double arch, baptistry, and repeating salmon brick.
